total_assets_before.meaning: totalAssets() of GrowthHYBR, the HYBR locked in the single GrowthHYBR-owned veNFT, before the external deposit_for() addition
total_assets_before.checkpoint: before external deposit_for() to the GrowthHYBR-owned veNFT

total_supply_before.meaning: totalSupply() of GrowthHYBR, total gHYBR shares, before the external deposit_for() addition
total_supply_before.checkpoint: before external deposit_for() to the GrowthHYBR-owned veNFT

total_assets_after.meaning: totalAssets() of GrowthHYBR after the external deposit_for() addition, including externally-added tokens
total_assets_after.checkpoint: after external deposit_for() to the GrowthHYBR-owned veNFT

total_supply_after.meaning: totalSupply() of GrowthHYBR after the external deposit_for() addition, unchanged because no shares are minted
total_supply_after.checkpoint: after external deposit_for() to the GrowthHYBR-owned veNFT

deposit_for_publicly_callable.meaning: VotingEscrow::deposit_for() is publicly accessible and allows anyone to add HYBR to any existing veNFT

first_depositor_shares_after.meaning: shares attributable to first depositors after the external inflation, reported as diluted to 0 shares
first_depositor_shares_after.checkpoint: after external deposit_for() to the GrowthHYBR-owned veNFT

assumptions: The external deposit_for() addition increases the veNFT locked amount and hence totalAssets() as described.
No shares are minted by the external deposit_for() call, so totalSupply() is unchanged.
The scenario concerns the single GrowthHYBR-owned veNFT.

unresolved.description: Report does not give a numeric formula or bound for share dilution beyond the ratio description; the zero-share outcome is represented qualitatively via first_depositor_shares_after.
Report does not state whether the attacker must be a depositor or hold prior shares before calling deposit_for().

limitations: The potential modality of the impact is preserved by treating the dilution as a conditional scenario rather than an inevitable outcome.
The exact zero-share numeric relation is not formalized because the report supplies no formula; only the qualitative dilution is recorded.
